key_insight: Under a full row rank condition, a closed-form tensor trace-ratio solution enables a randomized solver that replaces tensor eigenproblems with tensor least-squares computations.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets computational and memory bottlenecks in high-dimensional tensor analysis while supporting discriminative feature selection.
method: Derive a closed-form solution under the full row rank condition.
Build a randomized least-squares-based solver with theoretical error bounds.
Combine the solution with tensor ℓ₂,₀ regularization for sparse multilinear discriminant analysis.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on multiple public real-world benchmarks report improved efficiency and scalability, with competitive classification accuracy on some datasets.
watch_item: The closed-form result requires full row rank; applicability to rank-deficient data needs verification.
paper_title: Large-Scale Tensor Trace-Ratio Problem: Randomized Algorithm and Sparse Multilinear Discriminant Analysis via Closed-Form Solution
